band: content significance M1 refinement / M2 notable advance / M3 major advance / M4 breakthrough / M5 epochal, judged against the node's OWN Age.

Produced by a 13-batch classification pass (one Age per batch; A2, A8 in two, A9 in three) plus one cross-age consistency review whose overrides are recorded in 'review'. Hand-editable: the generator reads this file, never re-derives it.

strings: the audit category (C future system / F requires authoring) and reason for every corpus Eureka string that has no faithful machine mapping; strings mapped by the generator's rules are not listed.
techniqueCandidate: flagged for the Director (§11) — the node may belong to Techniques rather than Technology. NOT moved.
civics: the six Civics nodes, banded by hand in the same scheme (they are not corpus technologies).
